home.title: My Portfolio
home.about_text_1: I am a recent graduate in web development with a strong passion for building and improving online solutions. Over the past six months, I’ve had the opportunity to practice and gain hands-on experience in both UI design and website programming.

home.commitment_text: I am always eager to learn, ready to take on challenges, and committed to delivering high-quality work on time for my clients.
